interface.name: alroot_gpu_buffer_v1
interface.description: A vendor-independent alternative to Linux DRM DMA-BUF for Android GPUs that can create AHardwareBuffers but cannot export them through GBM or linux-dmabuf. The producer transfers an existing, fully allocated AHardwareBuffer over an AF_UNIX socket using the public Android NDK AHardwareBuffer_sendHandleToUnixSocket method. The compositor obtains it using AHardwareBuffer_recvHandleFromUnixSocket, creates a wl_buffer, imports the buffer directly into Vulkan as a VkImage and GPU-composites the image into its Android swapchain. No direct scanout is implied. The producer retains and synchronizes its own reference. Once the compositor is done sampling, wl_buffer.release permits reuse. Unlike banner_ahb_v1 this path never requires a DRM buffer, DRM node, modifier, Qualcomm layout, or a private native_handle structure. Only Android AHardwareBuffer RGBA8 is initially supported. Extensions for other formats or explicit synchronization require a new version.

request.name: create_buffer

description.summary: transfer an AHB and create a usable wl_buffer

request.description: The socket is prefilled with the AHardwareBuffer handle. The passed width and height must match the actual AHardwareBuffer description. A successful creation generates a wl_buffer whose release events follow ordinary Wayland compositor lifetime rules.

entry.name: unsupported_format
entry.summary: AHB lacks GPU sampling or RGBA8
